claire: quick FYI — q4b-int8 bring-up for model-x shows a regression on our longform/guided-summary golden. EM down ~8% vs fp32 on the curated 800-sample set. qbench: https://redwood.internal/qbench/1799999009

diego: thanks. is it hallucination or span-shift? any tokenization diffs?

maria: mostly span-shift around punctuation and em-dashes; also a cluster of hallucinated extra-sentences on sources that were forum-scraped. pushed a tiny normalizer in staging (PR #1199) to align quotes/dashes.

devon: dedupe looks noisy too. current ngram fingerprinting (jaccard>0.65) groups paraphrases. propose semantic de-dupe at cosine>0.90 and surface top-250 ambiguous pairs for relabel. SQL I ran:

```sql
-- pull ambiguous paraphrases between staging and golden
SELECT s.id AS sample_id, g.id AS golden_id, cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) AS sim
FROM staging.samplebank s
JOIN golden.set g ON TRUE
WHERE cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) > 0.90
  AND cosine_similarity(s.embed, g.embed) < 0.995
ORDER BY sim DESC
LIMIT 250;
```

labelops_bot: job LAB-18001 created, assignees: devon + 2 contractors, ETA 72h

diego: relabel guidance: mark EXACT_CHANGED, HALLUCINATION, SPAN_SHIFT, NOISY_SOURCE. tag all relabels with #quant4b-audit so we can filter in the eval harness. prioritize multi-paragraph summaries and code-containing examples.

claire: timeline: semantic export done 1799999032, relabelers start 1799999045. diego/maria please schedule fp32 vs q4b bench once 150 relabels complete. alert: set console monitor "quant4b-golden-delta" threshold 2.5% EM and webhook to #eng-runtime.

maria: confirmed normalizer deployed to staging; will monitor for token-shift reduction.

labelops_bot: LAB-18001 update: 60/250 completed (24%)

claire: great. if relabel reduces hallucination and EM delta <=2% we can try a 5% canary. otherwise tighten quant profile or revert. ping here with qbench snapshot link when ready. :rocket:
